en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large medieval castle complex with two tall, pointed-roof towers standing by a calm river, whose surface reflects the entire structure. The castle rises above tree‑covered slopes and a few smaller riverside buildings. In the foreground on the right are grassy banks and dense bushes with a tall tree, framing the view of the castle across the water. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
